Pharmacokinetic Interaction Among Amlodipine, Losartan, and Chlorthalidone after a Single Oral Administration in Healthy Male Subjects. Antihypertensive drugs are more potent when administered in combinations of two or three different classes of drugs. The objective of this study was to evaluate the pharmacokinetic interaction among amlodipine, losartan, and chlorthalidone.
